stem:
Zara's village keeps a farm and a park as human-made ecosystems. Farmers debate synthetic fertilisers and pesticides versus continuous soil nourishment with organic manure.

Which judgment best supports ecosystem health?

options.text: Organic manure supports soil health; synthetic fertilisers and pesticides can raise yields, but farming becomes unsustainable if not managed well.
Any farm or park supports ecosystem health automatically because it is human-made.
Synthetic fertilisers alone keep farming sustainable without further management.
A park supports ecosystem health only when it looks green.

teacher.key_rationale: Human-made ecosystems support health only when well designed and managed. Organic manure nourishes soil; synthetic inputs can help yields but need careful management. Being human-made or looking green is not enough.
